script: The Sun is not actually yellow. Seen from space, sunlight looks white. It contains all the colors of the rainbow mixed together. Our atmosphere scatters blue light, which makes the Sun look slightly yellow from the ground. At sunset its light passes through even more air, so it turns orange and red.
